actions.create-conversation.description: Creates a new conversation in Kustomer.
actions.create-conversation.props.custom: The Kustomer ID of the customer this conversation belongs to. You can get this from the "Get Customer" action or from the URL when viewing a customer in Kustomer.
actions.create-conversation.props.direct: "Inbound" means the customer initiated the conversation; "Outbound" means your team initiated it.
actions.create-conversation.props.extern: A unique identifier from your own system to link this conversation (max 256 characters).
actions.create-conversation.props.name.d: A short subject or title for the conversation (max 256 characters).
actions.create-conversation.props.replyC: The channel used to reply in this conversation (e.g. "email", "chat"). Leave empty to use the workspace default.
actions.create-conversation.props.status: The initial status of the conversation.
actions.create-customer.description: Creates a new customer record in Kustomer.
URL of the customer's profile image.
actions.create-customer.props.birthdayAt: Customer's birth date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z").
actions.create-customer.props.company.de: Name of the company the customer belongs to.
actions.create-customer.props.email.desc: Primary email address of the customer.
actions.create-customer.props.externalId: Unique identifier from your own system (e.g. your CRM or database ID). Used to link this Kustomer record back to your data.
actions.create-customer.props.phone.desc: Primary phone number in E.164 format (e.g. "+14155551234").
actions.create-customer.props.signedUpAt: When the customer registered, in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z").
actions.create-customer.props.username.d: The customer's username in your system.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get-custom-objects.description: Retrieves all custom objects (KObjects) for a given class in Kustomer.
actions.get-custom-objects.props.fromDat: Only return objects created or updated on or after this date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2024-01-15T00:00:00.000Z"). Leave empty to return all objects.
actions.get-custom-objects.props.klassNa: The API name of the custom object class to fetch (e.g. "order", "ticket"). You can find this in Kustomer under Settings > Custom Objects — it is the lowercase identifier, not the display label.
actions.get-customer.description: Gets a customer by ID from Kustomer.
actions.update-conversation.description: Updates an existing conversation in Kustomer.
actions.update-conversation.props.conver: The Kustomer ID of the conversation to update. You can get this from the "Create Conversation" action output or from the URL when viewing a conversation in Kustomer.
actions.update-conversation.props.direct: "Inbound" means the customer initiated the conversation; "Outbound" means your team initiated it.
actions.update-conversation.props.name.d: Update the subject or title of the conversation.
actions.update-conversation.props.replyC: The channel used to reply in this conversation (e.g. "email", "chat").
actions.update-conversation.props.status: Change the status of the conversation.
